<svg

  width="300"
  height="340"
  viewBox="0 0 300 340"
>
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#0d1117"/>
  
  <g font-family="Inter, system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="9" fill="#a0aec0" opacity="0.5">
    <line x1="40" y1="24" x2="80" y2="24"
          stroke="#a0aec0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="21" x2="40" y2="27"
          stroke="#a0aec0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="80" y1="21" x2="80" y2="27"
          stroke="#a0aec0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="60" y="19" text-anchor="middle">1 m</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Room: living -->
  <polygon
    points="40,40 200,40 200,220 40,220"
    fill="#1a1f2e"
    stroke="#2d3447"
    stroke-width="1"
  />
  <!-- spawn point -->
  <circle
    cx="114.41726104299386"
    cy="180.24465061305526"
    r="12"
    fill="rgba(251,191,36,0.3)"
    stroke="#68d391"
    stroke-width="1.5"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"
  />
  <circle
    cx="114.41726104299386"
    cy="180.24465061305526"
    r="3"
    fill="#68d391"
  />
  <!-- label -->
  <text
    x="120"
    y="130"
    text-anchor="middle"
    dominant-baseline="middle"
    font-family="Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"
    font-size="11"
    fill="#a0aec0"
    font-weight="600"
    letter-spacing="0.05em"
  >LIVING ROOM</text>

  <!-- Room: hallway -->
  <polygon
    points="200,40 260,40 260,140 200,140"
    fill="#1a1f2e"
    stroke="#2d3447"
    stroke-width="1"
  />
  <!-- spawn point -->
  <circle
    cx="230"
    cy="90"
    r="12"
    fill="rgba(251,191,36,0.3)"
    stroke="#68d391"
    stroke-width="1.5"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"

    cx="230"
    cy="90"

    font-weight="600"
    letter-spacing="0.05em"

  <!-- Room: foyer -->
  <polygon
    points="40,220 200,220 200,300 40,300"
    fill="#1a1f2e"
    stroke="#2d3447"
    stroke-width="1"
  />
  <!-- spawn point -->
  <circle
    cx="119.70142500145332"
    cy="258.80570000581326"
    r="12"
    fill="rgba(251,191,36,0.3)"
    stroke="#68d391"
    stroke-width="1.5"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"
  />
  <circle
    cx="119.70142500145332"
    cy="258.80570000581326"
    r="3"
    fill="#68d391"
  />
  <!-- label -->

    x="120"
    y="260"
    text-anchor="middle"
    dominant-baseline="middle"
    font-family="Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"
    font-size="11"
    fill="#a0aec0"
    font-weight="600"
    letter-spacing="0.05em"

  <!-- Exit: living-hallway -->
  <rect
    x="198"
    y="72"
    width="4"
    height="40"
    fill="rgba(99,179,237,0.25)"
    stroke="#63b3ed"
    stroke-width="1"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"
    rx="2"
  />

  <!-- Exit: living-foyer -->
  <rect
    x="80"
    y="218"
    width="60"
    height="4"
    fill="rgba(99,179,237,0.25)"
    stroke="#63b3ed"
    stroke-width="1"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"
    rx="2"
  />

    y="72"
    width="4"
    height="40"

    stroke-width="1"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"
    rx="2"

    height="4"

    stroke="#63b3ed"
    stroke-width="1"
    stroke-dasharray="4 2"
    rx="2"

    y1="40"

    y2="40"

    y1="220"
    x2="200"

    stroke-width="3"
    stroke-linecap="round"

  <g font-family="Inter, system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#a0aec0">
    <text x="16" y="258" font-size="9" opacity="0.6" letter-spacing="0.08em">COLLISION GEOMETRY VIEW</text>
    
      <rect x="16" y="264" width="12" height="12"

      <rect x="16" y="304" width="12" height="12"
        fill="rgba(251,191,36,0.3)" stroke="#68d391" stroke-width="1" rx="2"/>

    <line x1="16" y1="328"
          x2="46" y2="328"
          stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="332">Wall segment</text>
